create_idefics2_vision_mlp: create an Idefics2VisionMLP module with config and optional quantization for vision transformer feed-forward layers
build_idefics2_encoder_layer: build an Idefics2EncoderLayer with self-attention, layer norms, and MLP for a single vision transformer block
run_idefics2_encoder: run the Idefics2Encoder transformer with inputs_embeds and cu_seqlens to produce hidden states
create_idefics2_vision_embeddings: create Idefics2VisionEmbeddings that converts pixel values to patch embeddings with variable-resolution position IDs
run_idefics2_vision_transformer: run the Idefics2VisionTransformer forward pass with pixel values and patch attention mask to get last hidden state
